notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Phantom Steed.
easyPrerequisites: Revolutionist is exiled by Phantom Steed.
description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Declare Phantom Steed as an attacker. It triggers, creating a token copy of Revolutionist that's tapped and attacking.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn
